name: Bolt · Death ×2 · Earth
primary:
Lightning shoots from your hand into the creature you aim at (or the first one in your line of sight). In instant mode it strikes twice a second while held. Effects:
• Damage 4.5 ❤ lightning + 3 ❤ earth (lightning ×2 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Charge 126: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 6 targets in a row, jumps up to 6 blocks, 3.15 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Withering: −0.75 ❤ per second for 7.5 s
• Life drain: 2.25 ❤ damage, you heal 1.17 ❤
• Brittle (earth damage ×2) for 9 s
self_description:
